query: INSERT INTO command_log (command_run_id, text, truncated, total_bytes, written_at) SELECT id, $2, $3, $4, $5 FROM command_run WHERE id = $1 ON CONFLICT (command_run_id) DO UPDATE SET text = EXCLUDED.text, truncated = EXCLUDED.truncated, total_bytes = EXCLUDED.total_bytes, written_at = EXCLUDED.written_at
